itemListElement.name: Notta Pricing in 2026: What Each Plan Costs in the US

mainEntity.name: How much does Notta cost per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notta Pro costs $8.17 a month billed yearly or about $13.99 on monthly billing. Business costs $16.67 per seat a month billed yearly or about $27.99 monthly.
Yes. Notta's free plan includes 120 transcription minutes a month, but each conversation is capped at 3 minutes. It also includes 10 AI summaries a month.

mainEntity.name: How much is Notta Pro per year?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notta Pro costs $97.99 a year on annual billing, which works out to $8.17 a month. It includes 1,800 transcription minutes a month.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Notta Pro and Business?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pro gives 1,800 minutes a month for 1 user. Business gives unlimited transcription per seat, plus video recording, security controls, usage reports, and CRM and Zapier integration.
On annual billing they are close: Notta Pro is $8.17 a month and Otter Pro is $8.33. Otter's free plan is more usable, with 30 minutes per conversation versus Notta's 3.

mainEntity.name: Does Notta have a lifetime deal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notta's pricing page lists only Free, Pro, Business and Enterprise as of October 2026.
